title: 외모 표현 열 단어: 예뻐요? 잘생겼어요?
objective: By the end, you can describe a person's height, hair, and looks in short sentences like 키가 커요 and 머리가 짧아요.
summary: Learn ten basic words for describing what people look like, such as height, hair, and body shape.

task.title: Describe how people look
task.line: Use the ten words above to choose, change, and write the right Korean words.

words.meaning: to be tall (with 키); to be big. 키가 커요 = is tall
to be small; to be short (with 키)
words.exampleMeaning: That actor has a small face.
My younger sister has long hair.

words.meaning: to be pretty (people, things). Form: 예뻐요
to be good-looking, handsome. Say 잘생겼어요 for 'is handsome'.
to be slim (a polite, positive word)
words.exampleMeaning: My older sister is tall and slim.

words.meaning: to be fat (can be rude about people)
words.exampleMeaning: Our cat is a bit fat.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 우리 아빠는 (잘생겼어요 / 예뻐요). ② 이 꽃이 정말 (예뻐요 / 잘생겼어요).
Write the opposite word: ① 길다 ↔ ____ ② 크다 ↔ ____ ③ 뚱뚱하다 ↔ ____
Fill in the blank with 키 or 머리: ① 미나 씨는 ____가 길어요. ② 농구 선수는 ____가 커요. 190센티미터예요.
Change the word in brackets to the -아요/어요 form: ① 오빠는 머리가 (길다) ____. ② 제 동생은 키가 (작다) ____. ③ 아빠는 키가 (크다) ____.
Read and answer in Korean. 민호: 키가 커요. 머리가 짧아요. 날씬해요. / 준수: 키가 작아요. 머리가 길어요. 좀 뚱뚱해요. ① 누가 머리가 길어요? ② 민호 씨는 키가 커요?
Put the words in the right order: 머리가 / 예뻐요 / 길고 / 우리 딸은
answers: ① 짧다 ② 작다 ③ 날씬하다
① 길어요 ② 작아요 ③ 커요
① 준수 씨 (준수 씨가 머리가 길어요.) ② 네, 커요. (네, 키가 커요.)
